channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Louth veteran Duffy goes out on a high
item.description: Bevan Duffy has called time on his 13-year inter-county football career with Louth.

item.title: Dingle delight tempered by O'Connor's likely unavailability for 'Boden clash
item.description: Newly-crowned Munster club football champions Dingle are resigned to being without Mark O'Connor for their All-Ireland semi-final meeting with Ballyboden St Enda's early in the New Year.

item.title: 'I never thought I'd be back in this position again'
item.description: Aidan Walsh is on the All-Ireland trail once again, 15 years after winning the Sam Maguire with Cork and seven after claiming the All-Ireland club IHC title with his native Kanturk.

item.title: Burren celebrate record third Paul McGirr tournament success
item.description: Burren were crowned Paul McGirr Ulster U16 club football champions for 2025 when they overcame Bellaghy by 1-9 to 1-6 in last Sunday's final at a rain-soaked Páirc Ghearrdhroma in Dromore.

item.title: Harty Cup and Corn Uí Mhuirí quarter-final draws made
item.description: The draws for the Dr Harty Cup and Corn Uí Mhuirí quarter-finals have taken place.

item.title: O'Connor: Leinster title won't satisfy St Martin's
item.description: Rory O'Connor says St Martin's don't intend resting on their laurels after landing their maiden Leinster club SHC title last Saturday.

item.title: Geaney let the wind do the work for winning score
item.description: Conor Geaney has been reflecting on his last-gasp two-point free that handed Dingle a dramatic and historic victory over St Finbarr's in last Sunday's Munster club SFC final.

item.title: Kent joins GAA presidential race
item.description: Wexford GAA have nominated Derek Kent to run for GAA president at Congress next February.

item.title: Donnelly appointed St Eunan's manager
item.description: Kieran Donnelly has been appointed as the new St Eunan's senior football manager.

item.title: Fixture details for All-Ireland club hurling semi-finals announced
item.description: Parnell Park and Semple Stadium will host the All-Ireland club SHC semi-finals on Sunday 21 December.
